title: Windows 7 website, 2009
lede: Microsoft’s Windows 7 launch site as archived in November 2009.
summary: Pale sky ground, a glossy orange hero, a grass-mound icon, and glossy box shots.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 25 September 2026 and inspected. The archived page may lack some images or scripts that the live page had.

styles.note: Carries the style’s motifs: a pale sky gradient, a glossy hero with light streaks, a small green grass hill, and reflective product boxes. Judge by the rubric. The page drew its gloss with images, so the CSS fingerprint does not apply (see the style page).

observed: The page sits on a pale sky-blue gradient.
The hero is a warm orange panel with light streaks and a screenshot of the Windows 7 desktop.
The tour illustration is a small green grass mound with a tree.
Product box shots are glossy and green with highlights.
Links are blue with small round arrow icons.
interpretation: The launch site has more of the style than the [Vista site](ref:windows-vista-website-2007): nature motifs and glossy objects arrive in the web layer.

images.alt: Archived Windows 7 home page: a pale sky-blue background, a glossy orange hero reading “Introducing Windows 7. Your PC, simplified.”, a small green grass-hill illustration, numbered feature lists, and glossy green product boxes.
images.caption: First viewport of the [November 2009 archived copy](https://web.archive.org/web/20091101155741/http://www.microsoft.com/windows/windows-7/).
